title: The Corridor of Patient Return

features.name: door that remembers returning
features.desc-on-touch: Each apartment on this floor is the same door. You've stood before this exact threshold before. You will again.

features.name: hallway-tile that knows your footstep
features.desc-on-touch: The pattern repeats exactly every 3.2 meters. Your footfall finds the same crack each time.

features.name: windows showing the same dusk
features.desc-on-touch: The light through each window is identical. The architecture ensures you see the same sunset from every apartment.

features.name: the loop-junction where halls curve back
features.desc-on-touch: You arrived here. You are arriving here. You will arrive here again. Staying means recognizing this.

features.name: mirror-alcove showing returns
features.desc-on-touch: Each reflection shows you at a different time, all at once. The corridor holds every moment you've been here.

inscription: the hallway learned to return to itself, and then taught you that staying is just another word for patience

reverie.title: REVERIE — walking the corridor you'd already walked
narr: You and Katita walked this hallway for the
third time that day, or the thirtieth. She
said: it's the same. You said: we keep coming
back anyway. She took your hand and walked
slower. Not leaving meant choosing to arrive
over and over. You understood: that was love.
